title: Tourism & Hospitality Brief - Edition
description: One JSON file per edition. Numbers are stored ONCE as raw numeric values with unit, scale and comparison metadata - never as pre-formatted strings. PT and EN render the same numbers through locale formatting ('923,7 M EUR' vs 'EUR 923.7 M' is a rendering concern). All language-dependent text lives in pt/en sub-objects. The direction of any change is derivable from the sign of the number, never from a colour.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor autocomplete.

id.description: Edition identifier. Monthly: 'YYYY-MM' (e.g. '2026-07'). Quarterly: 'YYYY-Qn'. Half-year: 'YYYY-Hn'. Annual: 'YYYY'.

series.description: Series key. Fixed for Tourism & Hospitality Brief.

horizon.description: Editorial horizon. Drives the title convention in Templates Editoriais v1.0 s.6 and the [Horizonte] token in the PDF filename.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the data. Fixed to Portugal for the current series.

period.description: Reference period as numbers only. Month and quarter names are produced by the renderer per locale.

publishedAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the edition was published on the website.

dataStatus.description: Status of the underlying data for the whole edition. Must be surfaced in the edition header (Componentes Visuais v0.9 s.4).

historical.description: True for an edition published after its period, as part of the backfill; rendered as 'Edição histórica'.

historicalNote.description: Optional free sentence shown under the historical-edition notice, e.g. why the edition was published later or which data vintage it uses. Only meaningful together with historical: true.

version.description: Version of this content file, e.g. '1.0'. Independent from the PDF version.

signatureImage.description: Signature image filename, following THB_LinkedIn_Signature_[AAAA-MM]_[Mes-EN].jpg. PT and EN share the same file when it carries no translatable editorial text.

ogImage.description: Optional Open Graph image filename (1200x630 px). Falls back to the signature image when absent.

title.description: Normalised title per Templates Editoriais v1.0 s.6, e.g. 'Tourism & Hospitality Brief | Portugal | July 2026'.

takeaway.description: Executive takeaway shown on the series page and at the top of the edition. Recommended maximum length: 45 words per language (Componentes Visuais v0.9 s.4). This limit is a soft, maxLength-style constraint: it is NOT enforced by this schema, it is checked by the build script.

sections.description: Ordered content blocks, following the edition-page order of Componentes Visuais v0.9 s.3. Blocks 10 (PDF download) and 11 (previous/next navigation) are chrome, not content, and are therefore excluded.

localizedText.description: A single string in both languages. Never store numbers formatted inside these strings when the number also exists as an indicator value.

unit.description: Unit of a raw value. 'count' = number of people/nights/etc.; 'eur' = euro amount; 'percent' = a level expressed in %; 'pp' = percentage points; 'index' = index number; 'ratio' = dimensionless ratio.

scale.description: Multiplier that the stored value is expressed in. value 923.7 with scale 'million' means 923 700 000. The renderer appends the locale suffix (PT 'M', EN 'M').

decimals.description: Number of decimal places to render. Decimal separator and thousands separator are chosen by the locale, not stored here.

value.description: Signed magnitude of the change. The sign alone determines the direction shown; colour must never be the only direction cue.

unit.description: 'percent' = percentage change; 'pp' = percentage points (use for changes in a rate such as occupancy); 'abs' = absolute change in the indicator's own unit.

basis.description: Comparison basis: year-on-year (homologo), month-on-month or year-to-date (acumulado). Rendered as 'homologo' / 'YoY' etc. by the locale layer.

label.description: Optional override for the comparison caption when the default basis wording is not appropriate.

key.description: Stable machine key, unique within its section (e.g. 'guests', 'adr', 'netBedOccupancy').

value.description: Raw numeric value. Never a formatted string.

valueBasis.description: Whether the headline value is a level (default) or is itself a comparison, as in the Greater Lisbon 'overnight stays +0.4%' card. When it is a comparison, 'change' is normally omitted and the sign of 'value' carries the direction.

note.description: Optional supporting line on the card (Componentes Visuais v0.9: 'informacao adicional opcional').

status.description: Optional per-indicator override of the edition-level dataStatus.

indicator.description: One indicator card: label, raw value + unit, and comparison metadata.

title.description: Interpretative title, not a generic chart label.

period.description: Period and comparison basis of the plotted values.

key.description: Stable key for the bar; referenced by highlightKey.

value.description: Signed raw value. Bars below zero are read from the sign, not from colour.

highlightKey.description: Optional key of the item to emphasise. Must match the 'key' of one of the items.

altText.description: Alternative text / long description for screen readers. The accessible data table is generated from 'items'.

barList.description: Horizontal bar list (source markets, regions). Always accompanied by an accessible data table generated from items.

items.description: One row keyed by column key. Numeric cells are raw numbers; text cells are localizedText objects.

table.description: Tabular block. On mobile it may collapse into cards or scroll horizontally.

richText.description: Body copy as an array of paragraphs per language. No markup, no pre-formatted numbers that duplicate indicator values.

fact.description: What the data shows. No opinion.

interpretation.description: What it means. Explicitly separate from the fact.

implication.description: What it implies for investors, owners and operators.

lens.description: Tourism & Hospitality Real Estate Lens. The three parts are mandatory and must stay separate (Componentes Visuais v0.9 s.4).

signals.description: Numbered signals to watch. Numbering is generated by the renderer, never stored in the text.

releaseDate.description: ISO date on which the primary source released the data.

note.description: Optional production note shown on the cover.

sectionHeader.description: Block 1. Series, country + period, horizon, language, publication date and data status are rendered from the top-level fields; only cover-specific copy lives here.

reading.description: Interpretation of the indicator set, kept separate from the numbers.

scope.description: Geography or asset scope the indicators refer to, e.g. 'Grande Lisboa'.

sectionLens.description: Block 7. Perspetiva Imobiliaria / Real Estate Lens. Fixed title, distinct visual treatment.

sectionOutlook.description: Block 8. The section headline is 'outlook.intro' - it is not duplicated as a separate field.
